minutes.headline: Select Board chose TAPA Architects for the town building assessment and space needs study.
minutes.summary: The board granted a one-day beer and wine license with a warning about unpaid taxes. It approved the building reuse committee's recommended architect for the building assessment. It adopted an Affordable Care Act health insurance procedure and appointed a cultural council member. Committee and town manager reports covered the cemetery superintendent's retirement, Marshall Park, a fall special town meeting, streetlights and a solar proposal.

what_happened.line: A motion was made to accept the building reuse committee's recommendation and approve a contract with TAPA Architects for the building assessment and space needs study; the vote result was not audible.
The board took up a health insurance policy and procedure under the federal Affordable Care Act; the motion's result was not audible, and unbudgeted fiscal 16 exposure was discussed.
A motion was made on a one-day beer and wine license for the Lakeview Club, with discussion of the applicant's delinquent taxes; the vote result was not audible.
The town manager said a special town meeting would be set for sometime in September, for the fall.
Next Tuesday's meeting was set as a workshop on board and town manager goals, not televised; television resumes on the fifteenth.

why_it_matters: The architect choice starts the study of town buildings and space needs, which is likely to shape later capital requests that residents may be asked to vote on.
Offering health coverage to some variable-hour employees from January 2016 could add a cost not yet in the budget, which would fall on the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: A special town meeting is to be set for the fall, typically in November.
A possible board session on September 22nd on an animal control officer role proposal, with a packet a week before.
